rows.en: An eye poke, a leg sweep… then a killer combo with a low blow. How's that?
And by the way, I'll leave the low blow to you! Do your best! Ha ha ha…
What's with the "ha ha ha"! No way, absolutely not!
"Anyway, let's train!!" / "Just kidding… I was only joking."
Ugh, so mean! You heartless jerk!!
You're joking!? But your eyes were dead serious, you know?

…!? Huh? This isn't funny anymore…

All right, [HERO4]! We're going with the new combination attack!
Like I said… absolutely no way!
Sis, I'm hungry. Hurry up and make dinner.
Is it that time already? Sorry, sorry… I'll make it right away, okay?

Ha ha, Aki… Is that what you were worrying about?

Here… Go asked me to give this to you…

He said he couldn't bring himself to give them to you, since you'd bought new shoes yourself…

Go isn't a shallow guy like that! His head's just full of how to beat that kaiju.

(Ugh…!?

A dream…

That's it! To beat it, I just have to jump over the barrier!)
Has Go come by here? He's gone missing from the hospital.
What!? With those wounds, where could he have gone?
If you get in touch with him, please tell him to go back to the hospital. And not to worry about MAT…
The kaiju has started moving! Well, I'll be going now…
Wait a minute… Maybe he went there?

Hirai Pass…

No doubt about it… Aki, you go! See with your own eyes what Go is doing there!
Do it, do it! Do it more!! Turn this whole area into a sea of flames!

The Black Cross Army! They mean to lure us out with this bombing, don't they?

But… until the New Gorenger Suits are ready, we can't sortie!
All riiight, we're sortieing in Varidreen! Damn the Black Cross Army…
Wait, Ao, you stay here! Your job is to bring the New Gorenger Suits to the front line as soon as they're ready.
Peggy, hurry and finish the New Ball too! The three of us are enough for the diversion.
So you've shown up? Reckless fools…
Grr… So they've come with guerrilla tactics! Spray the gas!
Commander! Aka and the others have been captured!
Mm… Going in head-on is no good. Let's circle around behind and use Varitank…
The New Ball is finished! With this, I'll have Diamond Mask spinning in circles.
Commander, the New Gorenger Suits have been loaded onto Varidreen!
Mm… Good, it seems everything is ready. Ao, Momo, I'm counting on you!

(Jumping power… I have to build up more jumping power!

If Ultraman can't win, then I'll win myself!

For that, I have to train my legs and back, and build up enough jumping power to leap over its barrier!)
(I'll jump over it… no matter what!)
Sis… Why is Go doing that?

He's retraining himself to beat the kaiju.

You couldn't do something like that without a really strong will.
Why are you an idiot, sis?
